wikitext: {{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Odyssey Village |image=Odyssey Village.png |characters=スミル村 |japanese=Sumiru Village |region=Kalos |epicode=XY007 |episode=Giving Chase at the Rhyhorn Race! }} '''Odyssey Village''' (Japanese: '''スミル村''' ''Sumiru Village'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Kalos]]. It is located between [[Santalune City]] and [[Lumiose City]]. It is a small settlement that holds the starting point for a {{p|Rhyhorn}} racetrack and a [[Pokémon Center]]. In ''[[XY007|Giving Chase at the Rhyhorn Race!]]'', {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} were making their way back to Lumiose City after having visited Santalune City. On the way, they were almost trampled by a group of racing Rhyhorn. Soon after, an [[Officer Jenny]] arrived on the scene and told them they were on a Rhyhorn racetrack, which is off-limits to travelers. She then took them to Odyssey Village. There, Ash decided to participate in a race and borrowed a Rhyhorn from the Rhyhorn rental place.
